Subject: POC trial planning: RACI & next steps (ClearLake Health)

Hi Chris / Maya team,

Thanks again for the time today — good conversation and excited to align on a short trial/POC. Below is a concise recap and proposed RACI so we can lock owners and timelines. Please confirm or correct anything I’ve missed.

POC objective / success criteria (proposed):
- Integrate Redwood Inference to power patient summary generation for triage workflows (accuracy >= 85% on the sample set)
- End-to-end latency <= 600ms median for 512-token requests under expected traffic
- Cost target: <= $0.004 per generated token (batching/quantization to be applied)

Evaluation plan / deliverables:
- Redwood provides a POC instance + onboarding runbook + sample prompts (we'll share test harness).
- ClearLake provides a representative dataset (anonymized) and access to a staging environment for integration tests.
- Joint evaluation: nightly automated scoring + a 1-week manual review by clinical SMEs.

High-level timeline (proposed):
- Week 0 (by Jun 17): Confirm owners, sign POC Addendum/PO, exchange non-prod access details
- Week 1 (Jun 18–24): Redwood provisioning, test harness setup, initial integration
- Week 2 (Jun 25–30): Run evaluation, collect metrics; mid-week sync to review progress
- Week 3 (Jul 1–7): Final run + closeout report and next steps/rollout discussion

Ownership (please confirm):
- Infra / network access: ClearLake IT (please name primary contact)
- App / integration owner: ClearLake Integration Lead (API connections, staging)
- Security / compliance: ClearLake Security (data anonymization, audit requirements)
- Procurement / contracting: ClearLake Procurement

Redwood RACI (proposed):
- Responsible: Redwood (Marissa) — POC delivery, runbook, monitoring setup
- Accountable: Redwood Solutions (Aditya) — technical onboarding and config
- Consulted: Redwood CS (Lauren) — success criteria and SME coordination
- Informed: Redwood Sales Lead (Rishi) — commercial/renewal coordination

Attachments: I attached a draft success criteria spreadsheet and our POC runbook.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm ClearLake owners for Infra, App, Security, and Procurement by EOD Friday (Jun 12).
2) If owners are confirmed, we'll send the POC Addendum and schedule a 60-minute kickoff for Jun 15–18.
3) Aditya will follow up with a technical checklist once infra owner is confirmed.

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
